cohort: 165 pregnant women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (44 with gestational hypertension, 86 with pre-eclampsia, and 35 with eclampsia)
finding: Increased maternal serum uric acid levels were associated with pre-eclampsia and eclampsia compared to gestational hypertension, and were associated with adverse fetal outcomes and increased instrumental and operative interventions.
mod_finding: 62 (31.51%) of the participants underwent cesarean section (14 in the gestational hypertension group, 28 in the pre-eclampsia group, and 20 in the eclampsia group); 103 (62.42%) had a vaginal delivery.
